findings: Brine, freezing point and melting are distinct terms. Salt is not described as creating cold without an energy transfer.
Transfer is the general action; conduction is the stated wall mechanism and insulation reduces external input.
Stirring, crystal formation, temperature and uniformity address different observations. Unused mixture, saturated, solid, thermal and volume were checked across all slots.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: salt water solution直接定义brine盐水。mixture泛混合物不命名所述盐水种类，volume体积、conduction过程、crystals固粒不合。
point liquid begins ice定义freezing point冰点。melting point为固转液方向相反，thermal泛热性质不命名这相变点，其他词不合。
ice changes absorbs energy语境为melting融化。freezing冰成固放出热的过程非此叙述，mixture混合物、volume体积不是冰的融化。
heat from warmer towards colder需transfer传递。stirred为过去分词、thermal形容词等不作could后的原形动词；其他候选无这项动作。
through wall direct contact material定义conduction传导。transfer泛转移不具体命名墙内接触机制，volume体积、mixture混合物不是机制。
reduce room heat arriving定义insulated隔热。saturated饱和、solid固态、thermal热的均不表示加阻热保护，其他词不合。
avoid unmoving layer，contents被搅动stirred。insulated外层隔热不使内容混合，saturated饱和、uniform均一为性质非此过程动作。
small solid structures form定义crystals晶体。mixture泛混合、brine液盐水、volume体积不是复数固态结构；其他候选词性不合。
how hot cold定义temperature温度。volume体积、thermal形容热、conduction传导不同于测冷热程度量。
similar throughout rather edges different定义uniform均匀。solid仅固态不保证各处一致，saturated饱和也非空间均匀，其他项不合。

findings: Rotation, periodic repetition and discrete light sampling are different properties. The apparent stationary or reversed direction does not establish a physical reversal.
Interval differs from frequency, and synchronisation concerns timing correspondence rather than mere sampling.
Unused blur, exposure, frequency, transparent and vibration were checked across all slots; the prose supplies the observation so no film is missing.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: turn around centre定义rotation旋转。vibration振动不特指绕中心周转，frequency频率是运动属性、exposure曝光非这类动作本身。
regular repeating cycle定义periodic周期性的。continuous持续不保证规律周期，stationary静止相反，transparent透明与运动形式无关。
short bursts light定义flashes闪光。exposure是受光过程单数非复数光脉冲，blur模糊、frequency频率不是这些一阵阵光。
between successive bursts定义interval间隔。frequency单位时间次数，exposure单次受光时段不等相邻间的距离，direction方向不表时差。
position one moment not whole motion为sampled取样。synchronised只是时序对应不表记录瞬间样本，stationary静止性质非采集动作。
same visible place despite movement定义stationary表观静止。continuous不断不等不移动，transparent透明、periodic周期不等停在同处。
mark progress other way指direction方向。rotation可泛旋转但此处reverse后明确other way所指方向，且第1空锁其运动名称；其他词不合。
described mismatch discrete samples named aliasing混叠。blur模糊是失清晰而非采样产生错误运动模式，exposure受光、vibration振动不命名该现象。
timing corresponded定义synchronised同步。sampled取样不必时刻对应，periodic周期也可能不同步；其他项不合。
light present without breaks定义continuous连续。transparent透明、stationary不动、periodic重复都不等常亮不中断；其他词词性不合。

findings: Single loop and whole fabric are explicitly contrasted; an earlier loop/stitch pairing was removed before publication because their ordinary knitting meanings could overlap. Rows and columns remain different directions.
Tension and slack concern force/looseness, twisted orientation and unravel loss of linked structure. Repair is described by a restored connection.
Unused cast, elastic, knitted, purl and uniform were checked across all slots; intentional patterns are not automatically called faults. No unseen fabric is needed.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: open yarn ring直接定义loop线圈。fabric是整体织物而非单一圆环，needle工具、purl一种针法、tension拉力均非这段开放环本身。
fabric指连接线圈形成的整片织物，后文sheet-like textile直接定义。loop是单个环而非整片，rows/columns是片内排列方向，needle为工具，purl为针法，其他词不命名这里的整体纺织物。
slender tool carries loops定义needle织针。purl是针法、loop是线环、fabric为织物都非工具。
horizontal lines across样片定义rows横行。columns为纵列，loop单环、purl针法不是横向多针排列。
vertical through successive lines定义columns纵列。rows横行已对照，其他候选不指纵向单位排列。
pulling force yarn定义tension张力。elastic为可伸缩形容词、uniform均匀、purl针法、stitch针目不是施拉力。
excess looseness rather intended pull定义slack松的。elastic弹性是伸缩性质不等松弛，uniform均匀不能解释过松，knitted已织不评松紧。
turned crossing different定义twisted扭转。knitted织成只过程不说明交叉异常，repaired修好与此局部不同形态不等同，其他词不合。
linked structure coming undone定义unravel脱散。cast原形可投放但不指线圈结构逐步松脱，purl为针法动词非自行散开；其他候选不合。
connection restored定义repaired修复。twisted扭转是差异之一，knitted已织不保证故障修复，elastic属性非恢复连接，其他项不合。

findings: Solvent, dissolved sugar and solution distinguish medium/process/mixture. Saturation is tied to stated conditions, not visual clarity.
Evaporation differs from dissolution; crystalline describes structure and nucleation the onset of growth.
Seeds are starter crystals, impurities unwanted material and yield recovered quantity. Unused particles, precipitate, stirred, transparent and uniformly were checked across all slots.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: liquid in which sugar dissolves定义solvent溶剂。solution是糖水整体，precipitate固态析出物、particles颗粒不单指承担溶解的水。
no separate grains sugar入液定义dissolved溶解。evaporated进空气、stirred搅拌不保证溶开，crystalline形容结晶态与此不同。
dissolved material together liquid定义solution溶液。solvent只液媒不是整体，precipitate为析出物，particles粒非均一溶液状态。
as much dissolved allowed conditions定义saturated饱和。transparent透明不能证已至上限，crystalline晶态是固体排列，其他项不合。
water into air定义evaporated蒸发。dissolved溶入不等进气，stirred搅动不是相变，其他候选无该过去分词。
structure arranged crystal定义crystalline结晶的。saturated是溶液容量状态，transparent透光不说明晶格组织，其他词不合。
initial structure growth begins定义nucleation成核。precipitate是析出固体而非开始形成核的过程，solution体系、yield量均不等。
existing tiny crystals start growth称seeds晶种。particles泛粒不一定既有晶体用作起始，impurities为不想要异物，其他候选不合这个角色。
unwanted introduced material定义impurities杂质。seeds是有意提供生长核，particles只是形态不说明杂入，precipitate是析出产物不一定外来。
recovered amount procedure定义yield回收产量。solution为体系、solvent液媒、precipitate产物种类都不直接指收得量。

findings: Agenda, proposal, draft and decision occupy different stages; the record does not imply discussion alone approved an event.
Objection and clarify distinguish a concern from understanding it. Assign, owner and deadline turn a decision into a defined next action.
Minutes are a checked summary rather than a guaranteed verbatim transcript. Unused anonymous, consensus, quorum, recorded and unanimous were checked across all gaps.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: planned business list定义agenda议程。minutes为会议后记录、proposal单建议、decision结果、quorum法定出席数都非讨论清单。
suggesting new event not approved定义proposal提案。decision已定结果，objection反对意见、deadline期限不是这项待审建议。
open revision not final定义draft草稿。consensus共识、quorum出席数、minutes会议记录不等于当前活动文稿可改版本。
stated concern cost定义objection异议。proposal原建议、decision决定、consensus共识均非担忧反对。
what estimate included需clarify澄清。assign是分任务不是说明费用构成，其他候选不作to后该原形动词。
named agreed outcome under rules定义decision决定。consensus全体共识不是本文必定程序，unanimous形容词也不合a后名词，proposal提案未定不是结果。
give responsibility task to person定义assign分派。clarify澄清对象内容不等给责任，其他词不作此任务分配原形。
person responsible action定义owner责任人。quorum人数阈值、agenda清单、minutes文档、deadline时限均非承担行动者。
time by completed定义deadline截止期。decision结果、agenda列表、quorum人数、minutes记录均非该完成时限。
meeting decisions actions record定义minutes纪要。draft草稿是版本状态非文类，agenda事前清单、proposal单建议均不指会后决议行动记录。

findings: Strings, characters and digits name different levels. Alphabetical and numerical comparison are distinct rules.
Case handling, shared prefix and exact duplicate checking are separate identity/comparison issues. A common beginning does not merge people.
Stable refers to equal-key order, and ignore affects comparison rather than stored display spelling.
Unused collation, entry, suffix, lexical and sequence were checked for exact definitions and grammar; sort order is not claimed universal across languages.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: sequences symbols in computer定义strings字符串。entry条目是列表角色非数据符号序列类型，sequence单数不匹配复数typed names，collation排序规则不是输入对象。
symbols within strings定义characters字符。digits只数字子类不包名字字母，duplicates重复条目、prefix开头部分不是每符号。
following alphabet定义alphabetical字母顺序。numerical按数、lexical虽泛词汇相关但本题专明字母表且其余规则另定，stable相等键顺序不等字母序。
upper lower letters定义case大小写。suffix后缀不表示大小写区别，prefix前缀、collation整体排序规则不具体命名字母大小写属性。
symbols representing numbers定义digits数字字符。characters泛符号第2空已用且此处特指数值表示，prefix开头不必数字，other nouns不合。
interprets as numbers定义numerical数值比较。alphabetical按字母、lexical按文本词汇，stable只保相等键原序，不表示数字值读取。
beginning part text直接定义prefix前缀。suffix为结尾片段，与beginning相反，entry整体、sequence序列不特指前段。
exact repeated entries定义duplicates重复项。characters是符号、strings是所有输入并不说重复，digits数字非完全同条；其他候选不合。
equal keys preserves earlier order定义stable稳定排序。lexical词法、alphabetical字母、numerical数值各可稳定也可不稳定，均不定义该保序性质。
leave selected marks no influence定义ignore忽略。其他候选无可接would后的该原形动词，保原拼写展示不同于比较时忽略符号。

findings: Pool, premium, claims and exposure have distinct contract/price/request/risk-scope roles.
Independent versus correlated loss and diversification are stated model properties; policy count alone does not diversify a shared storm.
Reserve is explicitly a provision rather than cash; liquidity timing differs from the broader solvency assessment.
Unused actuarial, deductible, transfer, underwriting and volatility were checked across all gaps. No insurer is assessed or certified.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: grouped insurance contracts为pool风险池。transfer转移、underwriting承保过程、reserve准备金不是这些合同汇集体的名称。
price paid cover定义premium保费。deductible为自负额非购买保障价格，reserve为未来义务准备、claims为申请赔付，均不等。
requests payment under contracts定义claims索赔。premium收价、exposure风险敞口、reserve准备不是申请支付的复数请求。
extent risk taken defines exposure风险敞口。volatility波动度不同于所承担范围，premium价格、solvency能力非这一风险总敞口概念。
without specified dependence定义independent独立。correlated趋同相反，actuarial精算性质不说明相关结构，other terms不合形容词。
same storm tend occur together定义correlated相关。independent相反，actuarial仅领域属性，其他候选不表损失共同变动关系。
spread relevant risks reduce concentration定义diversification分散化。underwriting承保范围更广不等于分散，transfer转移一项也非这里明确跨风险分布策略。
provision expected future claims定义reserve准备金。liquidity立即支付能力、premium进款、deductible自负额不是这个会计准备；不等现金。
meet payments when due定义liquidity流动性。solvency总体偿付条件不同，reserve记账准备不保证能即时付款，其他名词不合。
broader ability obligations assessment定义solvency偿付能力。liquidity短期付款可用不等整体义务覆盖，volatility波动、premium价格均不是该能力。

findings: Crossover and period describe repeated-condition structure; sequence and randomisation concern order and assignment.
Carryover is persistence, washout the intended diminishing interval; washout is not guaranteed to remove every influence.
Within-person comparison does not remove time variation. Assessor masking is distinguished from participant knowledge.
Unused allocation, baseline, endpoint, volunteer and withdrawn were checked across all slots. The text gives no actual intervention protocol.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: same participant both conditions different times定义crossover交叉设计。allocation分配总过程、baseline起点、endpoint结果不指同人轮换结构。
defined time span each condition定义period阶段。sequence为阶段次序、baseline开始值、endpoint终点不是持续时间段本身。
intervention label defined treatment处理。volunteer为参与者、endpoint测量结果、allocation分配不命名被比较条件处理。
order conditions定义sequence顺序。comparison为比较过程、period单阶段、baseline起始状态都不是先后组合。
chance rather chosen order定义randomised随机化。masked为不知标签而非随机选序，withdrawn为退出，其他候选不作该分配性质分词。
effect persists first into next定义carryover残留效应。washout间隔旨在减残留而非残留本身，variability泛变化、baseline基线不直接指前期延续影响。
interval allowing effects diminish定义washout洗脱间隔。baseline起始时点不保证留间隔，endpoint结果、allocation分配不是这里的阶段之间等待。
within participant comparing two conditions定义comparison比较。allocation把人或序分派不同于条件结果对比，variability是差异现象不是比较动作。
differences changes across periods为variability变异。carryover仅一种延续效应不能概括所有差异，baseline起点、endpoint单结果非总变化。
assessor unaware condition defines masked遮盲。randomised指抽分不保证不知道，withdrawn退出不是保评者不知，其他候选不合。

findings: Bitstream, redundancy and codec name data, compactable structure and implementation. Lossless requires exact recovery; lossy admits approximation.
Quantisation changes representable levels; sampling and latency are different concepts. Perceptual similarity is not bit identity.
Decoding is not itself a no-loss certificate, and storage includes required supporting information.
Unused entropy, latency, sampling, semantic and transmitted were checked across all slots. No file or hidden audio/image is required.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: sequence binary symbols直接定义bitstream位流。codec程序、entropy信息量性质、storage空间不是组成文件的符号序列本身。
repeated predictable structure compact representation对应redundancy冗余。entropy是不确定性度量不同于可省重复，latency延迟、sampling取样不命名此重复信息。
recover exact original defines lossless无损。lossy允许丢近似反义，perceptual感知标准不保证逐符号恢复，semantic意义层也不保证。
original sequence identical requirement需exact完全精确。perceptual是感知、semantic是意义，不保二进制全同，lossy有损与无损定义矛盾。
permits discard approximate定义lossy有损。lossless反义，perceptual是评判标准但非许丢的编码类别，semantic不定义该保证。
map smaller available levels定义quantisation量化。sampling从位置时刻取值不同于减少表示层级，latency延迟、entropy不确定度不是映射过程。
listener viewer can notice定义perceptual感知的。semantic关注意义可保意义也有可察差别，exact符号一致反而本段不保证，其他项不合。
encoding decoding implementation定义codec编解码器。bitstream被处理数据、storage空间、latency时延非执行编解码方法的组件。
appropriate procedure reconstruct output定义decoded解码。transmitted传输只是移送不等解释还原，lossless形容性质不能作该动作，其他项不合。
space representation plus supporting info定义storage存储量。latency是时延、entropy是理论性质不是本次文件所占存储，bitstream数据序列非空间需求本身。

findings: Metaphor is not a literal construction; source bridge and target argument map selected relationships, not every property.
Salience, connotation and conventional familiarity are distinct. Context supports an inference without proving every possible association intended.
Unused analogy, polysemy, pragmatic, register and transparent were checked against all slots and grammar; no external literary text is needed.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: argument was bridge跨域描写并非实物，called a metaphor隐喻。analogy虽相关但需an且通常显比较形式，此句教师命名隐喻；polysemy多义不是该句映射术语。
no physical construction直接说明not literal非字面。figurative是随后正向描述，transparent透明不表真假实物，pragmatic语用不等字面。
understand one through another定义figurative比喻性的。literal字面相反，conventional惯常不必比喻，register为名词语体不合。
ideas drawn from bridge定义source来源域。target是被解释的argument相反，context场景、register语体不指提供映射的一域。
argument to be understood定义target目标域。source为提供桥梁概念的域，context周边、connotation关联义均不指被阐释的对象域。
especially noticeable定义salient显著。transparent透明可易懂不等突出，conventional熟悉也未必聚焦某特征，literal字面不指注意度。
associated feelings values beyond definition定义connotation内涵联想。polysemy是多个意义结构、analogy比较关系、register语体不等附带情感价值。
through familiarity become conventional惯常的。transparent易明白未必惯常，salient突出、literal字面、pragmatic语用都不说明熟用地位。
who spoke what preceded定义context语境。register只语言风格层次，polysemy词多义、analogy比较均非完整交际环境。
conclusion drawn wording situation定义inference推论。metaphor表达方式本身、connotation关联值、context环境都不是读者据此形成的结论。

findings: Magnitude is event size, intensity local effects and epicentre a specified location. They are not treated as one number.
Acceleration, velocity, displacement and duration are defined by different quantities/units.
Site conditions qualify distance-related attenuation; no universal nearest-strongest rule or actual event prediction is claimed.
Unused aftershock, amplitude, recorded, saturation and spectrum were checked across all slots; no missing waveform or building assessment is involved.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: breaking slipping fault定义rupture破裂。aftershock是后续地震非断裂过程名，displacement位置变是测量量不是此故障过程总称。
event size measure定义magnitude震级。intensity局部效应强度不同，amplitude单波幅不等完整事件大小指标，duration时长不等震级。
effects particular location定义intensity烈度或影响强度。magnitude源事件大小，amplitude运动峰值属性不完整等局地影响评估，其他词不合。
surface above rupture start定义epicentre震中。site泛观测点不特指源点正上，spectrum谱、aftershock后震均非该位置。
rate velocity changes定义acceleration加速度。velocity位移时间率、displacement位置差、amplitude幅值不等速度变化率。
position change per time定义velocity速度。acceleration速度变化率，displacement位移本身，duration时间长不合。
change position itself定义displacement位移。velocity、acceleration都多时间率，amplitude为幅值大小不是这里所定义位置改变量本身。
extent in time直接定义duration持续时长。magnitude事件大小、spectrum频谱、saturation饱和都不表示这段时间长度。
ground at observing place定义site场地。epicentre特定震中不等每个观测处局地，recorded分词、amplitude幅值非地点修饰名词。
reduction motion propagation distance model定义attenuation衰减。saturation饱和、spectrum频谱、aftershock后震都不指传播中振动减弱现象。

findings: Unit, assignment, randomisation and baseline are different design elements. Control is a defined comparison, not a promise of zero experiences.
Exposure and compliance are separate from receiving an invitation. Spillover concerns indirect effects on connected nonrecipients.
Cluster allocation needs matching design; stable conditions cannot be inferred from a shared programme name.
Unused attrition, untreated, variance, version and weighted were checked across all gaps. No real social experiment or personal data is used.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only audit only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: entity counted analysis定义unit分析单位。cluster是一种分组单位但此处概念可账户人家庭，assignment为分配、version为版本均非通用分析实体概念。
allocated group记录定义assignment分配。exposure实际遇到、compliance遵从均后续事件，variance变异不指被划到哪条件。
used chance allocation定义randomisation随机化。attrition退出、spillover间接效应、baseline起点、control比较组不指抽签分配。
stated comparison arrangement定义control对照条件。untreated未接受可处理性质但不保证无事，本文强调对照非绝对空白，weighted加权非条件名。
before intervention starting state定义baseline基线。version版本、assignment分配、exposure接触不等前测起点；其他词不合。
what actually encountered定义exposure实际接触。assignment仅机会分配、compliance遵从是接触与分配关系不等本身，其他名词不合。
following allocated arrangement定义compliance遵从。exposure只是遇到可能非分配安排，attrition退出相反事件，variance变异不表遵从。
effect reaches nonrecipients neighbours定义spillover溢出效应。attrition是流失、variance总变异、version版本不是间接受益，其他候选不合。
group connected purpose定义cluster群组。unit泛单位但第1空已锁总定义，这里特指一起分配的组；version版本、control条件不等连接群体。
unchanged relevant respects定义stable稳定。weighted为加权而非条件不变，untreated未处理、randomisation名词均不说明跨比较相关条件一致。
